The TXT separates A. DETERMINISTIC EVIDENCE from B. GEMINI-ASSISTED INTERPRETATION, retaining status, limitations, prior-risk UNAVAILABLE and user-claim caveats.
This is the buyer-facing vehicle evaluation TXT, not stage2-report.docx / stage2-report.pdf. CREATE_NEW prevents overwriting; no multi-file rollback or durable session database is claimed.
Aliases continue from A. Freshness uses actual report revision, saved records, generation ID and reference-year checks. Existing Java, tests, reports, credentials and UML-01–07 are untouched.

sd B3 — facade resumes after A: guarded cache, then GUI completion
All failures retain Java evidence. No automatic corrective or F09 transient retry.
Costs/constraints remain Java facts; prior risk and final category remain AI interpretations.
Narrative validator checks covered accident/maintenance claims clause by clause.
NO cannot become reported accidents; DOCUMENTED is not missing or complete history.
Then reject digits, prohibited age/condition terms and covered constraint contradictions.
These are targeted English guards, not universal factual or mechanical verification.
ReportSchema: category, strengths, risks, missingInformation, costSummary,
constraintConflicts, inspectionPriorities, nextSteps, explanation. No extra properties.
Parser: strict bounded JSON; string sections; no duplicate keys/items; valid category.
Exact costSummary; supported strengths subset; five required evidence sets unchanged.
Four advisory categories: Strong Candidate · Consider with Caution · High Risk
· Insufficient Information. Category and generation status are separate concepts.
Strong Candidate additionally needs sufficient evidence, no violations, Low risk and a first-year estimate.
sd B2 — accepted categories and exact validation boundaries
EvaluationReport = content; ReportEvidence = authoritative context; ReportEvaluation
= generation/status envelope. AI_UNAVAILABLE and insufficient states are cacheable too.
[synthesis failure] AI_UNAVAILABLE; report=null; no invented recommendation.
REQUEST_BUILD: local prompt/schema construction failed before a request.
LLMFailure.diagnostic(): configuration / timeout / HTTP / provider envelope.
REQUEST_FAILURE: unclassified client/request exception (details withheld).
REPORT_STRUCTURE: parseReport rejected JSON, fields, types, bounds or category.
REPORT_EVIDENCE: validateReport rejected evidence or supported prose claims.
[accepted structure + evidence] AI_SUCCESS; report=validated EvaluationReport.
[insufficient Java evidence] INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION
report=evidence.insufficient(); category=Insufficient Information; no AI call.
alt generation outcome → ReportEvaluation(id,status,report,evidence,message)
